changes: Backtest display now respects the selected time range.
The last backtest row is marked to latest price only when that row belongs to the database latest month.
Historical ending ranges such as 2010-2020 remain on tradeStart to tradeEnd basis and are no longer extended to the current live price date.
The latest holdings live price box is hidden unless the final row is genuinely live-adjusted.
CSV Basis column now stays TRADE_END for historical final rows and becomes LATEST_PRICE only for true current/latest-month runs.
Audit fix: T-N signal date now honors Skip Month by using scoreBaseM instead of prevM.
Audit fix: CAGR years now use actual period count divided by annual periods, avoiding date-span understatement for monthly/half-month tests.
Audit fix: Backtest/CSV Holdings now represent end-of-period NAV weights; initial weights remain in targetWeights and stockRets.wNominal.
Audit check: latest-price display remains limited to cases where the selected backtest ending month matches the database latest month.
Corrected T-N / Skip Month separation: T-N only selects the fixed signal date inside the scoring month.
Skip Month is no longer forcibly disabled in T-N Backtest or T-N Sweep; checked = skip one rebalance period, unchecked = no skip.
T-N Sweep labels updated to state that Skip Month follows the current checkbox state.
FIX: Natural elimination extraTurnover now counts both sell and buy legs (x2), previously only counted sell side, understating NE friction cost by 50%.
FIX: SGOV wEff now accumulates across CASH+SGOV target keys instead of being overwritten by the last key; fixes display/CSV decomposition.
FIX: closureCostDiff now independently recomputes grossRet from stockRets and compares to running grossRet variable; previously was algebraically always zero.
FIX: Audit engine exposure formula check updated from stale min()/old-string logic to the actual multiplicative chain: vwmaExposureUsed * factorExposureMultiplier * marketPhaseExposure.
FIX: Sharpe is standardized as arithmetic annualized excess mean return divided by annualized sample volatility.
FIX: CAGR / annual return remain geometric compounding metrics and are not used as the Sharpe numerator.
FIX: Stress tests / rolling windows / Monte Carlo / random baseline Sharpe now use the same standard Sharpe helper.
DEFAULT: Pool page CORR WINDOW(MO) is set to 24 in both HTML and canonical settings.
Momentum formula remains 0.5*z12 + 0.3*z6 + 0.2*z3.
All stocks use daily momentum base N=60 by default.
z3=N, z6=2N, z12=4N in the selected underlying frequency.
Added adjustable Momentum Frequency/Base controls and Momentum Window Plateau Scan.
Plateau Scan fixes all other backtest settings and changes only the momentum z3 base N.

audit_notes.renderBT: uses getDisplayBTRecords() so the latest row is marked to latest price before UI metrics/table/chart are rendered
audit_notes.dlBtCsv: exports the same display basis and adds Basis=LATEST_PRICE/TRADE_END
audit_notes.renderLatestHoldingsPriceBox: already uses latest price and is now consistent with the latest monthly row
audit_notes.renderSignalPriceLine: signal page remains live/latest by design
audit_notes.WF_rolling_stress_factor_health: kept historical pRet/tradeEnd basis by design; no live price adjustment applied
audit_notes.natural_elimination: latest row extends the final leg from tradeEnd to latest price when finalCode/finalCapital are available
audit_notes.time_range_fix: getDisplayBTRecords() now gates adjustLatestRecordToLatestPrice() through shouldUseLatestPriceForDisplay(); selected historical ranges are not live-marked.
audit_notes.logic_audit_2026_05_20: Fixed calculation-correct-but-context-wrong issues: T-N skip-month bypass, CAGR date-span years, holdings label/data mismatch.
audit_notes.tn_skip_month: T-N and Skip Month are independent. runBTcore uses scoreBaseM = skip ? allM[idx-2] : prevM; getFixedTNDate is applied inside that selected scoring month.
audit_notes.ne_turnover_fix: extraTurnover was counting only one leg of each replacement trade. Now correctly counts sell + buy = 2x inherited capital.
audit_notes.sgov_weff_fix: SGOV wEff previously set to nominalW (last iteration only); now accumulates: (existing || 0) + nominalW.
audit_notes.closure_check_fix: closureCostDiff changed from netRet-(grossRet-totalCost) [always 0] to grossRet-closureGross where closureGross is independently recomputed from stockRets.wNominal * stockRets.ret.
audit_notes.audit_exposure_fix: Removed stale min(market,shield,adaptive) and 'VWMA * factorMultiplier' string checks. Now verifies vwmaExposureUsed * factorExposureMultiplier * marketPhaseExposure == finalExposure.
audit_notes.sharpe_definition: Sharpe = (mean(period_returns) * annualPeriods - rfAnnual) / (sampleStd(period_returns) * sqrt(annualPeriods)); rfAnnual defaults to 1.5%.
audit_notes.annual_return_definition: CAGR and reported annual return are geometric compound returns based on NAV, not linear mean*periods.

changes_market_phase_gate.ui: Backtest page now has Market Phase Gate: OFF / Diagnostic Only / Exposure Control plus Phase 1-6 exposure inputs.
changes_market_phase_gate.no_lookahead: Backtest period t uses only trailing completed factor-health rows before current period.
changes_market_phase_gate.diagnostic: Records marketPhase fields and CSV columns without changing returns.
changes_market_phase_gate.control: Multiplies final exposure by phase exposure; residual capital flows to SGOV through existing exposure-fill path.
changes_market_phase_gate.csv: Backtest CSV adds MarketPhase, MarketPhaseMode, MarketPhaseExposure%, FinalExposure%.
